targets.rawSql: SELECT date, AVG(price) FROM fact_prices JOIN dim_time ON fact_prices.time_id = dim_time.time_id GROUP BY date

SELECT county_name, date, AVG(price) FROM fact_prices JOIN dim_county ON fact_prices.county_id = dim_county.county_id JOIN dim_time ON fact_prices.time_id = dim_time.time_id GROUP BY county_name, date
